purpose: Diagnose the WSL systemd user-session warning for amx while preserving the working system-level BLACK service.
command:
set +e
echo '===USER_UNIT==='
systemctl status user@1000.service --no-pager -n 60 2>&1 || true
echo '===USER_SLICE==='
systemctl status user-1000.slice --no-pager -n 30 2>&1 || true
echo '===JOURNAL_USER_UNIT==='
journalctl -b -u user@1000.service --no-pager -n 120 2>&1 || true
echo '===LOGIND==='
systemctl status systemd-logind --no-pager -n 40 2>&1 || true
echo '===PAM_SYSTEMD==='
grep -R "pam_systemd" /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true
echo '===RUNTIME_DIR==='
ls -ld /run/user/1000 2>&1 || true
echo '===DBUS_USER==='
dpkg -s dbus-user-session 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Status|Version):' || true
